headword: {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}

definitions.explanation: The second level of architect certification in Japan, issued by prefectural governments. Holders are qualified to design smaller buildings, primarily residential structures up to a certain size.

examples.japanese: {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}の{免許|めんきょ}を{取得|しゅとく}した。
examples.english: I obtained my second-class architect license.

examples.japanese: {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}は{住宅|じゅうたく}の{設計|せっけい}を{担当|たんとう}できる。
examples.english: A second-class architect can be in charge of designing residences.

examples.japanese: {大規模|だいきぼ}な{商業施設|しょうぎょうしせつ}の{設計|せっけい}には、{二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}ではなく、{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: For designing large-scale commercial facilities, a first-class architect is required, not a second-class one.

notes:
The lower of the two main architect license levels in Japan (compared to {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}). The license is issued at the prefectural level, while 一級建築士 is a national license.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}{試験|しけん}: second-class architect examination
- {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}{事務所|じむしょ}: second-class architect firm
- {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}{資格|しかく}: second-class architect qualification
